recipe.sources: Eight high-overlap and eight minimal-overlap nonoverlapping 3-second native audio excerpts per fresh AMI meeting, selected on manual words only. Cohorts and annotated participants are disjoint from meetings named in repository evaluation documents at freeze.
recipe.reference: Gold is at least two distinct speakers with concurrent manually timed word ranges, quantized to 10 ms. High has at least 1.2 s of overlap, minimal has at most 0.1 s. All excerpts contain at least 2.45 s of annotated speech.
recipe.candidate: Compare a right-padded input and a separately centered, silence-padded input. Their native receptive fields use the same 270-sample grid. Agreement retains only frames whose two-speaker-class flags reproduce in both placements. Require 250 ms of contiguous frames in each arm.
recipe.evidence_gate: At least half of high excerpts correctly localized in every fresh meeting with no more than one marker on minimal overlap per meeting. Correct localization requires at least 0.30 temporal IoU and 0.50 recall of annotated overlap. Counts are not an AI decision.
recipe.decision_gate: Replay a separate 93-clip bank with known genuine and generated speech. A marker may withhold a primary AI flag only. Require at least two genuine false flags withheld, at most one synthetic hit withheld and zero clean synthetic losses.
